Name: 2L Lifestyle Hyder Wood Shelf Bookcase Tall, Brown
Colors: Brown

Designed with 5 wide shelves to offer ample room for storage Included anti-tilt safety feature fits securely to the wall and shelf Made of solid wood legs and MDF veneer with NC top finish Great for books storage or displaying decorative pieces Compact structure to fit in any small spaces(Dimension: 29.9” L x 15.9” W x 63” H)
